commits.author: joseegman-idoneea
commits.message:
fix: generate proper request body for schemas with required properties (#90)

* fix: generate proper request body for schemas with required properties

- Update processEmptyObject to handle schemas with properties but no type
- Include required properties in generated request body
- Fixes issue #87 (similar to #86)

Closes #87

* build: fix compilation on Java 21

- Update spring-cloud-contract dependencies to 4.2.1 (fixes invalid POM)
- Update Lombok to 1.18.34 (Java 21 compatibility)
- Add maven-compiler-plugin 3.13.0 with release 17 config
- Fix generics issue in processEmptyObject

* ci: trigger workflow

* build: bump commons-lang3 to 3.15.0

Spring Cloud Contract 4.2.1 pulls commons-text 1.11.0, which calls
Range.of() added in commons-lang3 3.13.0. Version 3.12.0 pinned in pom
caused NoSuchMethodError in OpenApiContractConverterTest#testRefsInsideArrays.
